business_summary.text: Integrated steel producer transitioning to a 65% flat product mix with a focus on internal raw material security and logistics cost reduction.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Hot rolled realization ranged from INR 51,000 to INR 60,000 in the last 3 months.

lab.quote: The TMT was somewhere about, again, INR 52,000 to INR 60,000.

call_memory.quote: The TMT was somewhere about, again, INR 52,000 to INR 60,000.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: TMT realization was between INR 52,000 and INR 60,000 in the last 3 months.

lab.quote: The structure was ranging from INR 60,000 to INR 65,000.

call_memory.quote: The structure was ranging from INR 60,000 to INR 65,000.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Structural steel realization ranged from INR 60,000 to INR 65,000 in the last 3 months.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Rails realization was more than INR 70,000 in the last 3 months.

lab.quote: There are certain clearances what we have to obtain. I think it should come in this financial year.

call_memory.quote: There are certain clearances what we have to obtain. I think it should come in this financial year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Utkal B2 coal mine clearances are expected to come in this financial year.

lab.quote: So, 3 more gasifiers, which is having capacity of 35,000 NM cube per hour each. That means 105,000 NM cube per hour that is being installed.

call_memory.quote: So, 3 more gasifiers, which is having capacity of 35,000 NM cube per hour each. That means 105,000 NM cube per hour that is being installed.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company is expanding coal gasification capacity by installing 3 more gasifiers of 35,000 NM cube per hour each, totaling 105,000 NM cube per hour.

lab.quote: And hopefully, these will be commissioned by June and the DRI also will be commissioned by June.

call_memory.quote: And hopefully, these will be commissioned by June and the DRI also will be commissioned by June.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The coal gasifiers and the DRI plant are expected to be commissioned by June.

lab.quote: Government is open to provide coal and with the exemption of 50% of royalty.

call_memory.quote: Government is open to provide coal and with the exemption of 50% of royalty.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Government provides coal for gasification with an exemption of 50% royalty.

lab.quote: We are better off compared to that because in the earlier calls also we had mentioned 2% of the SMS cost level, we have a benefit on account of the captive coal mine.

call_memory.quote: We are better off compared to that because in the earlier calls also we had mentioned 2% of the SMS cost level, we have a benefit on account of the captive coal mine.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Captive coal mines provide a benefit of about 2% at the SMS cost level.

lab.quote: And that's how you see during this quarter, Kasia consumption was 33% compared to last quarter, 25%.

call_memory.quote: And that's how you see during this quarter, Kasia consumption was 33% compared to last quarter, 25%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Consumption from captive Kasia iron ore mine rose to 33% during the quarter compared to 25% in the previous quarter.

lab.quote: So, on the INR 47,000 crores of the capex number, we have around INR 8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores available for the remaining plant like, DRI2 and other things to be completed and at the same time, some pending payments, which will be linked to the performance.

call_memory.quote: So, on the INR 47,000 crores of the capex number, we have around INR 8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores available for the remaining plant like, DRI2 and other things to be completed and at the same time, some pending payments, which will be linked to the performance.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Out of the INR 47,000 crores capex plan, around INR 8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores remains available for pending plants and payments.

lab.quote: But for this year, we continue to remain in the stated guidance of INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: But for this year, we continue to remain in the stated guidance of INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Annual capex is guided to remain between INR 7,500 crores and INR 10,000 crores for this year.

lab.quote: And during the H1, as I said, around INR 3,200 crores were spent.

call_memory.quote: And during the H1, as I said, around INR 3,200 crores were spent.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Capex incurred during H1 was around INR 3,200 crores.

lab.quote: But one thing which is missing, but you will see in our balance sheet that our Net debt-to- EBITDA ratio has now come down to 1.5x.

call_memory.quote: But one thing which is missing, but you will see in our balance sheet that our Net debt-to- EBITDA ratio has now come down to 1.5x.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA ratio decreased to 1.5x from 1.71x in the previous quarter.

call_points.text: FY27 production target of 11-11.5 MT and sales of 10.5-11 MT maintained.
Coking coal costs expected to rise by $20-$25 per tonne in Q3FY27.
Export volumes maintained at ~100,000 tonnes per month, primarily HRC and plates.
Net Debt/EBITDA improved to 1.51x; company aims to stay below 1.5x through the cycle.
Switched from propane to syngas (coal gasification), saving ~₹70/kg in fuel costs.
Roida iron ore mine currently non-operational pending forest department right-of-way.
FY27 production volume guided at 11-11.5 million tonnes and sales at 10.5-11 million tonnes.
Coking coal prices expected to increase by $20 to $25 per tonne sequentially in Q1FY27.
Total steelmaking capacity increased from 9.6 MTPA to 15.6 MTPA following Angul expansion.

operating_notes.text: Angul capacity expanded to 12.0 MTPA in FY26.
Steelmaking capacity expanded to 15.6 MTPA in FY26.
Value-added product share rose to 66% in Q1FY27 from 61% in Q4FY26.
New Angul blast furnace is at 11,000 t/day of 13,000 t/day capacity; Raigarh blast furnaces run at 100% utilisation.
Captive coal mix was about 50% in Q1FY27; iron ore backward integration rose to 28% from 16% last quarter, targeting 40% on an exit basis.
Jindal Paradip Port commenced commercial operations of Phase I capacity of 12.5 MTPA.
Sales volume increased QoQ supported by inventory liquidation in Q2FY27.
Raw material costs increased due to higher coking coal cost.
Slurry pipeline commissioned; expected to save ₹700/t on freight.
Kasia mine ramped up to 22,000 tpd, targeting 30,000 tpd.
Switched from propane to syngas for reheating furnaces, saving ₹70/kg.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹16,217.93 Cr; net profit ₹1,041.24 Cr (against a loss of ₹303.59 Cr a year earlier).
Jindal Steel reported FY26 consolidated gross revenue of ₹62,412 Cr and a net profit of ₹3,361 Cr, completing its Angul plant expansion to 12.0 MTPA.
JINDAL STEEL LIMITED uploaded the earnings call recording on May 2, 2026, at www.jindalsteel.in/performance-highlights-2.
Jindal Steel hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 2, 2026, guiding for FY27 sales volumes of 10.5-11 million tonnes.
Jindal Steel's Q1FY27 call (July 25, 2026) reported adjusted EBITDA of ₹2,667 Cr and PAT of ₹844 Cr, with net debt/EBITDA at 1.71x and the slurry pipeline targeted for commissioning in August.
Jindal Paradip Port commenced commercial operations of its Phase I 12.5 MTPA capacity ahead of schedule.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹16,678.54 Cr (+42.7% YoY), net profit ₹770.64 Cr (+21.3% YoY).
Jindal Steel reported Q2FY27 consolidated net revenue of ₹16,704 Cr and PAT of ₹771 Cr; with net debt dropping to ₹14,786 Cr.
Audio recording of earnings call held on October 23, 2026 uploaded to company website.
Jindal Steel reported record Q2FY27 revenue of ₹19,448 Cr and commissioned its 192-km iron ore slurry pipeline.
